data.name: Aliyyah
data.gender_notes: Aliyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the name 'Ali', which means 'elevated' or 'sublime'. In Islamic context, it is a name given to girls, signifying their noble and exalted status. The name Aliyyah carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aliyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aliyyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aliyyah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: عليّة
in_arabic.meaning: عليّة تعني العلو والرفعة في الدين والخلق
in_arabic.long_meaning: عليّة هي اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل 'عَلا' الذي يعني الارتفاع والعلو. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الرفعة في الدين والخلق، والسمو في الأخلاق. وفي القرآن الكريم، نجد أن هناك آيات تشير إلى العلو والرفعة كقيمة روحية، مثل 'وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَمَا كُنْتُمْ' (الحديد: 4). يشير اسم عليّة إلى الشخصية التي تتسم بالكرامة والرفعة، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التاريخ الإسلامي كدلالة على المكانة الرفيعة.

in_urdu.name: علیہ
in_urdu.meaning: علیہ کا مطلب ہے بلندیاں، رفعت، اور اچھائی
in_urdu.long_meaning: علیہ ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے فعل 'عَلا' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بلند ہونا یا رفعت حاصل کرنا۔ اردو میں، یہ نام بلندیاں، رفعت، اور اچھائی کے مفہوم کے ساتھ استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام ان نساء کے لیے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے جو اپنی اچھائی، کرم، اور روحانی بلندیاں کے لیے جانی جاتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: अलीया
in_hindi.meaning: अलीया का अर्थ है उच्चता, उत्कृष्टता और सच्चाई
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलीया एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है उच्चता, उत्कृष्टता, और सच्चाई। इस नाम का उपयोग हिंदू और मुस्लिम समुदायों में समान रूप से किया जाता है, और यह नाम उन लड़कियों के लिए चुना जाता है जो अपनी उच्च आदर्शों, सच्चाई, और नैतिक मूल्यों के लिए जानी जाती हैं।

in_pashto.name: عليہ
in_pashto.meaning: عليہ معنی لوړوالی، عزت، او نیکۍ
in_pashto.long_meaning: عليہ د ښځو یو نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا نوم د لوړوالی، عزت، او نیکۍ معنی لري. په پښتو کلتور کې، دا نوم د هغو ښځو لپاره کارول کیږي چی د دوی د لوړوالی، شرافت، او نیکۍ لپاره پېژندل کیږي.

in_english.name: Aliyyah
in_english.long_meaning: Aliyyah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic root 'ʿ-l-w' which means 'to rise' or 'to be elevated'. In Islamic tradition, the name Aliyyah signifies an exalted, noble, and virtuous personality. It reflects qualities such as high moral character, dignity, and spiritual elevation. The name has been used historically across various Muslim cultures to denote a person of elevated status, whether in terms of spiritual standing or social respect. The Quran references the concept of elevation and exaltation in several verses, emphasizing the importance of rising above base qualities and aspiring to moral and spiritual heights.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Aliyyah' is of Arabic origin and holds a significant place in Islamic culture. It is a name rooted in nobility, elegance, and historic significance. Throughout Islamic history, numerous renowned women have held this name, most notably Lady Fatima Al-Zahra (pbuh), the daughter of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), and his wife, Lady Aisha (ra). The name 'Aliyyah' is also synonymous with strength and resilience, as exemplified by Lady Khawlah bint Al-Azwar who defended the Muslims during the Battle of Uhud. Furthermore, it is a symbol of rich heritage and pride within the Islamic community, and is often used as a name for newborn girls.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Aliyyah' holds deep spiritual significance in Islam. It is derived from the name 'Ali', which is associated with being exalted or sublime, and is a reminder of the great status that all believers possess in the eyes of Allah. The name is often seen as a reminder of the elevated position that we as believers hold, as it is mentioned in the Quran, "And indeed, you did have excellent examples in Ibrahim and Hadhara and the people of the house [of `Imran] and the prophets, men who submitted [to Allah ]. And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have a Garden, the Fulfillment [i.e., Paradise]" [Quran 3:35-36]. The spiritual significance of this name also encourages individuals to strive for excellence in their faith and actions, as they are reminded of the exalted position they hold in the sight of Allah.
